title: Understanding Confidence Intervals
text: Confidence intervals provide a range of values within which we expect the true parameter to lie with a certain level of confidence. In this case, we have 95% confidence intervals for the parameters.

title: Interpreting Confidence Intervals
text: If a confidence interval for a parameter includes zero, it suggests that the parameter might not be significantly different from zero. This means the corresponding variable might not have a significant effect.

title: Analyzing the Given Intervals
text: Look at the confidence intervals for each parameter: \(\theta_0\), \(\theta_1\), and \(\theta_2\). Determine if any of these intervals include zero.

title: Checking \(\theta_0\)
text: Does the confidence interval for \(\theta_0\) include zero?

title: Checking \(\theta_1\)
text: Does the confidence interval for \(\theta_1\) include zero?

title: Checking \(\theta_2\)
text: Does the confidence interval for \(\theta_2\) include zero?

title: Conclusion from Confidence Intervals
text: Based on the confidence intervals, \(\theta_1\) might not be significantly different from zero, suggesting that the corresponding variable might not have a significant effect.
